import { type JSX } from 'solid-js';
import type { StructuredListContract, StructuredListItem } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface StructuredListProps extends StructuredListContract {
    title?: string;
    onToolbarAction?: (detail: {
        id: string;
    }) => void;
    itemActions?: (item: StructuredListItem) => JSX.Element;
    pagination?: JSX.Element;
}
export declare function StructuredList(props: StructuredListProps): JSX.Element;
